column1: # Class Tree node catalog (flat). Join to SimpleMind via sm_label = topic text.
# Language: contemporary Standard Mandarin (普通话) as used in Mainland China,
# simplified characters. Regional forms only when useful. See README.md.
# Lesson kind (game_mode is the source of truth):
#   vocab = compounds (Greetings) or foundations (Basics, Nationalities, topic
#     word lists). Memorize characters. TSV is a word bucket, not sentences.
#   cloze = grammar drills and topic-companion sentence drills. Fill a blank.
# Topic vocab (Family … Feelings) ships with a companion cloze spur except
# Greetings, Basics, Nationalities, Work places (Talk about work covers
# Job titles and Work places), and At home. Grammar glue (很, 觉得, 在, 去) stays on cloze
# unless the vocab set is specifically those words (Basics).
# Companion cloze size: 20 sentences covering the paired vocab as blanks,
# not a four-word sample; 30 when 很 / 太 are mixed into the blank list, or
# when Talk about work blends Job titles and Work places.
# game_mode: compounds = Greetings. foundations = vocab composition.
# cloze = Question words, Negation, Modals, A-not-A, Adverbs, Connectors,
# Predicates, This and that, Prepositions, Directionals, Time, Towards, Tense,
# and topic companions (Talk about …, plus Table talk).
# idiom = Idioms 1 and Idioms 2. English situation, pick the idiom.
# unlocked: 1 = eligible once graph unlock rules pass
# content_tsv: class starter set (copied into new files; existing courses are untouched)
# List order = row order. Filename number is that list number (class_04 is the 4th lesson). Nationalities is 36 and has no TSV, so the next file is class_37.
# icon: key from TopicCategoryIcon.byKey (food, palette, greetings, …). Blank = match title.
# Companion cloze list rows show the paired vocab icon plus the talk/chat icon.
# Scene study sets (Body parts scene, Clothes scene, At home) and photo sets
# (Weather, Family, Job titles) are still vocab. They play only those rows.
# The list title matches the category lesson. Scene cards and photo cards
# both show the photo icon beside the category icon. No companion cloze,
# and no listening or sentence twin.
# Vocab and cloze cards split into listening and sentence lessons in the app.
# Stars show progress and do not change the puzzle.
# examples: list-view preview on the same line as the title (map bubbles stay [title]).
# Comma = vocab list; slash = contrasting cloze fillers. More than 3 items → first 3 plus ..
